thig16.1:3.2: She uses the term _bhavagata_ (“state of life”) seven times. It is not found elsewhere in early Pali, only once in the late [pe5:72.2]().
thig16.1:55.3: A reference to the metaphor for gluttony at [mn67:17.1]() and [an4.122:3.1]().
thig16.1:58.3: The same sense is expressed in prose at [an5.227:1.3]().
